objective: Implement R33: PICKUP rerun flag (is_rerun) and BROADCAST (special broadcast) schedule type across DB/RPC/types and calendar, admin and request UI
acceptance_criteria: Step 1 (DB/RPC/Types, GPT Codex): add idempotent sql/migrations/MIGRATION_R33_SCHEDULE_RERUN_AND_BROADCAST.sql and mirror into sql/SCHEMA.sql: extend schedule_type CHECK on game_schedules and schedule_requests to VERSION/PICKUP/CONTENTS/BROADCAST; add is_rerun BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false to both tables with CHECK (is_rerun = false OR schedule_type = 'PICKUP'); approve_schedule_request copies is_rerun on insert/update; sync_version_expenses_trigger keeps working for BROADCAST; update database.types.ts, request-validation.ts (+tests), sql/tests/TESTS.sql, sql/README.md, SRS/SPEC.

Step 2 (UI, GitHub Copilot): admin schedule form and RequestSubmissionModal support BROADCAST and a PICKUP-only rerun toggle (reset when type changes); admin requests page, desktop calendar banners, hero sidebar, weekly list and games ScheduleTree show BROADCAST label and a rerun badge using semantic tokens; existing game/official filters pass the new values through; writes tolerate an unapplied migration (omit is_rerun unless true, readable error on missing column or CHECK violation); Vitest tests added.
Step 3 (Review, Claude Opus): integrated static review of Base..Target, review.json/test.json/run.json schema validation, main merge and docs closeout, plus production migration checklist.
